en.name: Black vinegar (Taiwanese)
en.summary: Taiwanese black vinegar is not a straight vinegar: it is vinegar blended with vegetable and fruit extracts, sugar, salt and spices, which is why it tastes rounder and darker than a plain rice vinegar. Unopened it keeps about 2 years in the cupboard. Once opened, expect about 12 months.
en.pantry: The cupboard is the right place: cool, dark, tightly capped, away from the hob. An unopened bottle keeps about 2 years, and an opened one about 12 months. Because this is a seasoned blend rather than a plain vinegar, it has more to lose in flavour than a straight vinegar does, and sediment settling out of the bottle is normal — shake before use. Keep it out of the light and cap it tight; air and sunlight cost it more than time on the shelf does.
en.fridge: Black vinegar does not need refrigeration, and the published figures for it are cupboard figures. If your kitchen is hot and a bottle is going to sit unused for a long stretch, the fridge does no harm and slows flavour loss, but it is not required for safety. Either way, the important habits are the same: cap it tightly and wipe the neck, because the sugar in a seasoned vinegar makes drips sticky.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for black vinegar and no reason to freeze it. It is an acidic, shelf-stable seasoning that keeps itself, and freezing would only crystallise the sugars and cloud the liquid. Keep the freezer for things that genuinely need it.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould around the neck or cap, usually in sticky residue
A flat, dusty taste with none of the original aroma — old rather than unsafe
Anything solid floating in the bottle beyond the usual fine sediment
A bottle stored in sunlight that has visibly faded or thickened
tips: Shake before pouring; the seasonings settle.
Wipe the neck after every pour so the cap does not glue itself shut.
Do not substitute it into a pickling recipe that calls for 5 percent acidity — a seasoned blend is diluted with non-acid ingredients and is weaker than a straight vinegar.
Keep it separate from Chinkiang vinegar in your head and on the shelf; they are different products with different jobs.

faq.q: How long does black vinegar last after opening?
faq.a: About 12 months capped in a cool dark cupboard. Unopened, about 2 years.

faq.q: Does black vinegar need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. A cool dark cupboard is the standard. The fridge does no harm but is not needed for safety.

faq.q: Can you use black vinegar for pickling?
faq.a: Not in a recipe that specifies 5 percent acidity. It is a seasoned blend diluted with non-acid ingredients, so its acidity is lower than a straight vinegar's.

faq.q: Is Taiwanese black vinegar the same as Chinkiang vinegar?
faq.a: No. Taiwanese black vinegar is a blended seasoning; Chinkiang vinegar is a straight aged glutinous-rice vinegar. They are stored the same way but taste quite different.

zh.name: 烏醋
zh.summary: 台式烏醋不是純醋：它是在醋裡調入蔬果萃取、糖、鹽和辛香料的調味醋，所以味道比米醋圓潤、顏色也深得多。未開封放櫥櫃大約 2 年；開封後大約 12 個月。
zh.pantry: 櫥櫃就是它該待的地方：陰涼、避光、蓋緊、遠離爐火。未開封大約 2 年，開封後大約 12 個月。因為它是調味過的混合醋而不是純醋，能損失的風味比純醋多，瓶底出現沉澱也是正常的——用之前搖一搖。務必避光並蓋緊；空氣和陽光對它的傷害，比放在架上的時間更大。
zh.fridge: 烏醋不需要冷藏，它公布的數字講的都是櫥櫃保存。如果你的廚房很熱，而某一瓶又會擱很久，放冰箱不會有壞處，也能減緩風味流失，但這不是安全上的必要。無論放哪裡，關鍵習慣都一樣：蓋緊、擦瓶口，因為調味醋含糖，滴出來會黏。
zh.freezer: 烏醋沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。它是酸性、可常溫保存的調味料，本來就能自我保存，冷凍只會讓糖結晶、液體變濁。冷凍庫留給真正需要的東西。
spoilage: 瓶口或瓶蓋周圍在黏垢處長霉
喝起來扁平無味、完全沒有原本的香氣——那是老了，不是不安全
瓶中出現細沉澱以外的固體漂浮物
曾被陽光直射，顏色明顯褪掉或液體變稠
tips: 倒之前搖一搖，調味料會沉澱。
每次倒完擦瓶口，免得瓶蓋黏死。
不要拿它代替配方指定 5% 酸度的醃漬用醋——調味醋被非酸性原料稀釋過，酸度比純醋低。
在腦中和在架上都把它和鎮江醋分開；兩者是不同產品、用途也不同。

faq.q: 烏醋開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。未開封大約 2 年。
不用。陰涼避光的櫥櫃就是標準做法。冰了無害，但安全上沒有必要。
指定 5% 酸度的配方不行。它是被非酸性原料稀釋過的調味醋，酸度比純醋低。

faq.q: 台式烏醋和鎮江醋一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。烏醋是調味混合醋，鎮江醋是純釀的陳年糯米醋。保存方式相同，但味道差很多。
